E1.配方: 1.0 M LiTFSI，DOL/DME 1:1 v/v，1.0 wt% LiNO3（商品）

E2.配方: TTE : 2 m LiTFSI/DME（含 0.1 m LiNO3）= 4:1 v/v（折合约 0.4 m LiTFSI、0.025 m LiNO3）

C1.正极: 裸硫正极 S/Super P/PVDF 6:3:1，常规隔膜
C1.原句: Li/S cells with bare sulfur cathode using TDE and LS002 electro- lyte were assembled respectively (sulfur loading of ≈1.2 mg cm-2, equals to areal capacity at around 2 mAh cm-2), as shown in Figure 6a, all the batteries were charged/discharged at 0.5 C (equals to current density at around 1 mA cm-2).

C2.正极: 同 C1，碳涂层纤维素隔膜（CS）

C4.正极: 高载量裸硫正极（CS 隔膜）

比较.溶剂化依据: Raman：TDE 中 TFSI- 峰移向 1244.8 cm-1，接近 5 m LiTFSI/DME，形成接触离子对；TTE 几乎不与 Li+ 配位（同篇实验）；UV-vis 透明电池：TDE 中 Li2S6 峰弱得多

指标.原句: thus the bare sulfur cathode-based Li/S batteries using TDE electrolyte shows relatively lower dis- charge capacity (≈200 mAh g-1 at 0.5 C) than LS002 electrolyte.
But it also brought some positive effects, the cycling stability of TDE electrolyte-based Li/S batteries is improved, the discharge capacity keeps almost unchanged over 900 cycles.

As shown in Figure 6a, batteries using TDE electrolyte coupled with CS separator showed much higher discharge capacity (first dis- charge capacity 903 mAh g-1 at 0.5 C) than cells using TDE electrolyte alone.
When coupled with CS separator, batteries using LS002 electrolyte showed slightly higher discharge capacity than batteries using TDE electrolyte during the first 200 cycles.

After 1000 cycles, batteries using TDE electrolyte coupled with CS separator shows 49.4% capacity retention, on the contrary, batteries using LS002 electrolyte coupled with CS separator is only 23.7% of the initial capacity remaining.

the poten- tial gap between anodic peak, and cathodic peak of Li/S cells using TDE electrolyte coupled with CS separator is 0.239 V, which is much smaller compared to Li/S cells using LS002 electrolyte

指标.取值点: 充满后静置 72 h 开路电压
指标.原句: OCV of cells using conventional LS002 electrolyte shows an obvious decay from 2.35 to 2.15 V, which indicates severe capacity loss during resting (Figure S7, Supporting Information).
Bat- teries using LS002 electrolyte coupled with CS separator shows initial discharge capacity of 1671.5 mAh g-1, then the capacity is sharply declined.

TDE-CS separator- based batteries electrolyte shows initial discharge capacity of 1557 mAh g-1, close to theoretical capacity, and after 100 cycles the capacity of batteries still remains 870 mAh g-1.

The initial discharge capacity of Li/S batteries using LS002 electrolyte coupled with CS sep- arator could reach up to 1223.9 mAh g-1, however, the dete- riorated anode/electrolyte interface (Figure 6i) lead to low CE value (lowest CE value is at around 80.6%, the highest CE value is at around 93.8%) and rapid capacity decline.

The first discharge capacity of Li/S batteries using TDE electrolyte coupled with CS separator could reach up to 1187 mAh g-1, after 56 cycles, discharge capacity of 806 mAh g-1 remained, CE is higher than 97%.
